summary: Ceragon Networks Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its participation in the 10th Annual Lake Street Best Ideas Growth Conference on September 10, 2026, in New York City. Management will hold one-on-one meetings with attending investors. The filing is a routine investor relations announcement with no financial terms, transactional details, or special-situation elements. It discloses no acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or other strategic events. The disclosure merely informs shareholders of an upcoming conference appearance, representing standard corporate communication for a foreign private issuer.
